meta.name: hunt-sqli
meta.description: Hunting skill for sqli vulnerabilities. Built from 12 public bug bounty reports including modern NoSQL injection (Rocket.Chat CVE-2021-22911 MongoDB $regex, Mongoose ORM CVE-2024-53900 $where bypass), modern ORM raw-fragment SQLi (Django CVE-2024-42005, Sequelize GHSA-wrh9-cjv3-2hpw), second-order SOQL injection (HackerOne Salesforce), time-based blind SQLi in GraphQL resolvers, and SQLi on OIDC-proxy backends. Use when hunting SQLi / NoSQLi on any target.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你寻找 SQL 和 NoSQL 注入漏洞。它会分析目标网站的参数、技术栈和响应，给出测试步骤、检测 payload 和绕过技巧，并指导你验证和报告漏洞。
howto.when: 当你要求它进行 SQL 注入或 NoSQL 注入漏洞挖掘时触发，例如你说“帮我测试这个网站有没有 SQL 注入”或“检查这个 API 的搜索参数”。

say.text: 帮我测试这个搜索接口有没有 SQL 注入。
say.note: Claude 会分析参数并给出测试 payload。

say.text: 检查这个登录接口是否存在 NoSQL 注入。
这个参数有报错，帮我确认是不是 SQL 注入。
say.note: Claude 会指导你进行布尔盲注或时间盲注验证。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will help you find SQL and NoSQL injection vulnerabilities. It analyzes target parameters, tech stack, and responses, providing testing steps, detection payloads, and bypass techniques, and guides you through validation and reporting.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to hunt for SQL or NoSQL injection vulnerabilities, e.g., "Test this site for SQL injection" or "Check this API's search parameter."

say_en.text: Test this search endpoint for SQL injection.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze parameters and suggest payloads.

say_en.text: Check this login endpoint for NoSQL injection.
say_en.note: Claude will provide MongoDB injection payloads and methods.

say_en.text: This parameter shows an error; help me confirm if it's SQL injection.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through boolean or time-based blind testing.
